Name: Boss Encounters
Author: Duyihenxjdkwk
Description:
[size=4][b]描述[/b][/size]
Combat in Stardew never really escalates — learn a monster's pattern and the fight
is over before it starts. I wanted the mines to hold a fight you actually have to
move for, so this mod turns the monsters already down there into something worth
preparing for: any monster on a floor can mutate into a boss version of itself,
with telegraphed skills, extra phases and a colour palette of its own.
No new monsters are added. The boss is a creature the floor already spawned,
transformed where it stands.

原版的战斗很难有起伏——看清一只怪的套路，这场就结束了。我想让矿洞里有一场
真正需要走位、需要准备的仗，于是让本层已经刷出来的怪原地变异成首领版：
带预警的技能、额外的阶段、自己的配色。
没有新增任何怪物。首领就是那一层本来就有的东西，站在原地变了个样。

[size=4][b]安装说明[/b][/size]
Requires SMAPI 4.0.0 or later and Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.

1. Install SMAPI first and launch the game once through it.
2. Unzip the archive into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. The result must look like this:
  Stardew Valley/
  └── Mods/
      └── BossEncounters/
          ├── manifest.json
          ├── BossEncounters.dll
          ├── assets/
          └── i18n/
3. Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu to get the in-game settings page
  (Mod Options → Boss Encounters).
4. Launch the game through SMAPI again.
Settings are written to Mods/BossEncounters/config.json the first time you change something.
Close the game before editing that file by hand, otherwise the settings page will overwrite
your changes the next time you save.
[size=4][b]主要特点[/b][/size]

Any monster on the floor can mutate into a boss version of itself — 51 species, each with
its own name, stat line, elemental aura and skill set. No new monsters are added to the game.

- Six skills — charge, radial nova, projectile volley, rockfall, summon, blink. All telegraphed
  on the ground before they land, so every hit is avoidable if you read it.
- Two extra phases — at 70% and 35% health the boss brightens its colour, speeds up and casts
  more often. Phase 3 shifts it toward red.
- Elemental effects — fire, water, ice, lightning, dust, poison and shadow, drawn with the
  game's own sprites: fireplace flames, the fishing splash, a real three-pass lightning bolt,
  ground cracks, magic circles.
- One palette per boss — the mod samples the boss's own sprite, shifts it and recolours the
  creature, its aura, its ground rings, its health bars and every particle to match. A green
  slime boss fights in green.
- Screen-edge ambience — elemental motes cling to the four screen edges and jitter in place,
  denser and more violent as the boss loses health. No full-screen darkening, no vignette.
- Rarity-tiered loot — common materials scale with boss HP; second-tier (Dragon Tooth,
  Prismatic Shard) and ultra-rare (Galaxy Soul, Magic Rock Candy) rolls only unlock above
  certain boss HP, so early bosses cannot hand out end-game items.
- Pursuit — an unfinished boss follows you down floors and out of the dungeon, turning berserk
  outdoors. It will not enter the farm, farmhouse, cellar or greenhouse.
- Elites — a share of regular monsters grow larger and tougher, with a gold ring and flat
  damage reduction instead of inflated health.
- Monster gold — kills pay coins straight into your wallet, scaled by monster health.
- Every setting is a step picker, not a number — boss health (5), boss damage (5), skill
  frequency (4), monster health (5), monster damage (5), elite frequency (5), outdoor ambush
  rate (4). No juggling decimals to find a difficulty you like.

Outdoor ambushes are optional and on by default at the lowest rate. Outside the Mines and Volcano,
the moment you fell a tree, land a fish, break a rock or pick up a forage item, something may
notice. The farm never spawns. Turn it off if you only want dungeon bosses.

English and Chinese text are both included.

本层任何一只怪都能变异成首领版——51 种物种，各有自己的名字、数值、元素光环和技能组。
不往游戏里新增任何怪物。

- 六个技能——冲锋、环形爆发、弹幕齐射、落石、召唤、瞬移。全部先在地面画出预警，
  看得懂就都能躲开。
- 三个阶段——血量降到 70% 和 35% 各进一阶：配色变亮、提速、施法更勤，第三阶段整只转红。
- 元素特效——火、水、冰、雷、尘、毒、影，全部用游戏自带精灵绘制：壁炉火苗、钓鱼水花、
  真正分三笔画的闪电、地裂、魔法阵。
- 每个首领一套配色——程序读取首领自己的贴图，取主色后把整只怪、光晕、地面环、血条
  和所有粒子统一染成同一套色。绿史莱姆首领打出来就是绿的。
- 屏幕边缘氛围——元素碎屑贴着画面四边原地抖动，血量越低越密越凶。没有整屏压黑，
  也没有暗角蒙版。
- 战利品按稀有度分档——普通素材数量随首领血量增长；第二梯队（龙牙、五彩碎片）和
  超稀有（银河之魂、魔法糖冰棍）只在首领够厚时才解锁，前期首领不可能掉毕业装备。
- 追击——没打完的首领跟着你换层、跟出地牢，到地表会狂暴。农场、农舍、地窖、温室
  它进不去。
- 精英怪——一部分普通怪变大变厚，带金色环和固定百分比减伤，而不是靠堆血量撑。
- 怪物掉金币——打死直接进钱包，金额按怪物血量算。
- 所有设置都是档位，不是数字——首领血量（5 档）、首领伤害（5 档）、技能密度（4 档）、
  小怪血量（5 档）、小怪伤害（5 档）、精英概率（5 档）、野外刷怪（4 档）。
  不用去调小数找一个"刚好"的难度。

野外刷怪是可选项，默认开启但概率最低。在矿洞和火山以外，你砍倒树、钓上鱼、敲碎石头、
捡起采集物的那一刻，可能有东西注意到你。农场永远不刷。只想打地牢首领就把它关掉。

内含中英双语文本。

[code]Update History

3.17 — Boss bloom: a soft breathing halo around the boss sprite, using its own colour.

3.16 — The trial boss now uses the game's own Mr. Qi character model: four phases, brief invulnerability while changing shape, two shadows in the final phase. It also moved one floor before the Skull Cavern treasure rooms, and no boss spawns on a treasure floor any more.

3.15 — Introduced Mr. Qi's Trial, a dedicated boss in the dangerous Skull Cavern. Also fixed a boss double-spawn bug.

3.14 — Much steeper depth curves for the dangerous Mines and dangerous Skull Cavern, with a four-step growth setting (gentle / normal / steep / brutal).

3.13 — Boss strength scales with depth and has no upper cap; curves are per region (normal Mines excluded). Outdoor spawns scale with days played.


历史更新

3.17 — 首领泛光：在身上叠一层随呼吸涨落、使用自身主色的辉光。

3.16 — 磨练首领改用游戏本体的齐先生模型：四个阶段、转阶段短暂无敌、最后一阶段分出两个影子。同时挪到骷髅洞穴宝箱房前一层，宝箱层不再生成任何首领。

3.15 — 新增齐先生的磨练：困难骷髅洞穴的专属首领。同时修复了首领双份入场的 bug。

3.14 — 困难矿洞与困难沙漠的层数曲线大幅加陡，并加入四档增长梯度（平缓 / 标准 / 陡 / 极限）[/code]

Manifest.Name: Boss Encounters
Manifest.Description: Adds boss fights to the Mines, Skull Cavern and Volcano Dungeon. Any monster on the floor can mutate into a boss version of itself: 51 species, each with its own name, stats, elemental aura and skill set. Six skills, two extra phases, spawn and attack effects (fire, water, ice, lightning bolts, dust, poison, magic circles), dual health bars and rare loot. Surviving bosses chase you between floors and out of the dungeon, turning berserk outdoors. Also ships five monster difficulty tiers and elite variants. Everything is applied at runtime; no game files are edited.
Manifest.Author: Ayan
